poset_event_encoding: Each event is a literal ordered remove/add pair (x,y) from one retained exchange edge; sequences are compared as ordered tuples of these pair events.
interpretation_boundary: Retention fractions count current-contract optimum paths among ambient Johnson geodesics. Some retained-path languages require structure beyond a single pairwise precedence poset; whether that structure is state-dependent is measured separately. Neither result is a semantic probability or causal claim.
